Advanced tool · Diagnose

Startup Health Score

See how healthy your startup is across the metrics that matter.

This is an educational self-assessment, not financial advice or a valuation. It turns the numbers you enter into directional signals using the same formulas taught in the library — fill in whatever you have and leave the rest blank.

Your numbers

Enter any figures you know. Empty fields are simply skipped.

Advanced tool · Analyze

Startup Idea Analyzer

Turn your idea into a structured startup assessment.

This is an educational framework, not a prediction of business success. It scores how clearly and completely you've thought your idea through — a sharp assessment here still needs real customer validation.

Describe your idea

The more specific you are, the more useful the assessment. You don't have to fill every field.

Advanced tool · Target & plan

Target Audience Roadmap

Turn a rough sense of "who we're for" into a structured go-to-market plan — personas, segments, an audience priority score, recommended channels and an interactive launch timeline.

This is an educational planning framework, not market research. It structures what you already know into personas, scores and a timeline — the sliders reflect your assessment, so treat the outputs as directional prompts for real customer validation, not verdicts.

Describe your audience

Fill in whatever you know. The sliders drive the gauges and the priority score; the dates drive the Gantt chart.

Rate your audience 0–100

Launch plan

Set a start date and a rough length — every phase of the Gantt below is spaced from here.

Act · Your workspace

My Startup

Save your startup's profile and numbers once, then reuse them across the health score, what-if simulator and action plan. Everything stays on this device.

Tools · Understand

Metric Relationship Explorer

Pick a metric to see what moves it, what it moves in turn, and why it matters — so you can trace cause and effect across your business.

Act · Execute

30-Day Founder Action Plan

A focused four-week plan. It adapts to the weakest areas in your startup profile, and your progress is saved as you check tasks off.

Tools · Model

Startup Financial Model

A live 12-month projection of revenue, profit, cash and runway. Change any assumption and the table and chart recalculate instantly.

A simplified, deterministic planning model — assumptions compound monthly. Use it to explore trajectories, not as a guaranteed forecast.

Analyze · Validate

Business Idea Testing

A Strategyzer-inspired validation workflow: turn your idea into testable assumptions, rank them by impact and evidence, run cheap experiments, record real results, and get a Continue / Modify / Pivot / Stop recommendation. It reuses your My Startup profile and everything is saved on this device.

An educational testing framework. Statuses and recommendations come only from the real evidence you enter — nothing is pre-filled or fabricated.
